title: Please don’t wrap up your deal like a last-minute gift

content.text:
96

 Please don’t wrap up your deal like a last-minute gift
Hi Sara,
If you're feeling the December crunch, you're not alone.

Buyers and sellers alike are trying to close before the year ends.
But here's your friendly deal attorney PSA:

Rushing a transaction like it’s a last-minute gift run is how you end up with a deal that looks great on the outside and falls apart the second you open it.
The cure for regret in January?
Diligence.

Real, boring, document-heavy diligence.
Make sure the financials make sense.

Make sure the people in the business actually work there.

Make sure the seller owns what they’re selling.

It’s not festive.
But it’s necessary.
If you want to go into the new year with a deal you can actually live with, take the time now. Even if it slows things down.
Here for you through all the surprises,
Sara Sharp
Partner, SK&S Law Group
Founder of Deal Academy
